+WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+limitations under the License.
+*/
+
+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger tests SQL Server connections through a database tunnel.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping attempts to log in to SQL Server using the supplied database route.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 1 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid SQL Server port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+	connector.Dialer = sqlServerDialer{}
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	return trace.Wrap(conn.Close())
+}
+
+// The SQL Server driver uses the context for dialing but can block during login.
+// Close the underlying connection when the deadline expires to interrupt login.
+type sqlServerDialer struct{}
+
+func (sqlServerDialer) DialContext(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
+	conn, err := (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, network, addr)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	wrapped := &sqlServerConn{Conn: conn, done: make(chan struct{})}
+	go func() {
+		select {
+		case <-ctx.Done():
+			_ = conn.Close()
+		case <-wrapped.done:
+		}
+	}()
+	return wrapped, nil
+}
+
+type sqlServerConn struct {
+	net.Conn
+	done chan struct{}
+	once sync.Once
+}
+
+func (c *sqlServerConn) Close() error {
+	c.once.Do(func() { close(c.done) })
+	return c.Conn.Close()
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports a refused TCP connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	return errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) || err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports SQL Server login failures.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	if number := sqlServerErrorNumber(err); number == 18456 || number == 18452 {
+		return true
+	}
+	return err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "login failed for user")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports missing or inaccessible databases.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	if number := sqlServerErrorNumber(err); number == 4060 || number == 911 || number == 4064 {
+		return true
+	}
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	msg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
+	return strings.Contains(msg, "cannot open database") || strings.Contains(msg, "database does not exist")
+}
+
+func sqlServerErrorNumber(err error) int32 {
+	var pointer *mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &pointer) {
+		return pointer.Number
+	}
+	var value mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &value) {
+		return value.Number
+	}
+	return 0
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"strconv"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/common"
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/sqlserver"
+)
+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	server, err := sqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{AuthClient: setupMockClient(t)})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go func() { _ = server.Serve() }()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = server.Close() })
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(server.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.NoError(t, (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, PingParams{
+		Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb",
+	}))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingRejectsMissingParameters(t *testing.T) {
+	params := PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"}
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		set  func(*PingParams)
+	}{
+		{"username", func(p *PingParams) { p.Username = "" }},
+		{"database", func(p *PingParams) { p.DatabaseName = "" }},
+		{"port", func(p *PingParams) { p.Port = 0 }},
+		{"negative port", func(p *PingParams) { p.Port = -1 }},
+		{"port too large", func(p *PingParams) { p.Port = 65536 }},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			p := params
+			tc.set(&p)
+			require.True(t, trace.IsBadParameter((&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(context.Background(), p)))
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingHonorsDeadline(t *testing.T) {
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer listener.Close()
+	go func() {
+		conn, err := listener.Accept()
+		if err == nil {
+			defer conn.Close()
+			<-time.After(time.Second)
+		}
+	}()
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	start := time.Now()
+	err = (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, PingParams{Host: "127.0.0.1", Port: listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port, Username: "user", DatabaseName: "db"})
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.DeadlineExceeded)
+	require.Less(t, time.Since(start), 500*time.Millisecond)
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerErrorCategories(t *testing.T) {
+	p := SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name                    string
+		err                     error
+		refused, user, database bool
+	}{
+		{"nil", nil, false, false, false},
+		{"dial refused", fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", errors.New("connect: connection refused")), true, false, false},
+		{"login failed", fmt.Errorf("login: %w", &mssql.Error{Number: 18456, Message: "server error"}), false, true, false},
+		{"login failed value", fmt.Errorf("login: %w", mssql.Error{Number: 18456, Message: "server error"}), false, true, false},
+		{"unknown database", fmt.Errorf("login: %w", &mssql.Error{Number: 4060, Message: "server error"}), false, false, true},
+		{"unknown database value", fmt.Errorf("login: %w", mssql.Error{Number: 4060, Message: "server error"}), false, false, true},
+		{"other error", &mssql.Error{Number: 12345, Message: "other"}, false, false, false},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Equal(t, tc.refused, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(tc.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tc.user, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(tc.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tc.database, p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(tc.err))
+		})
+	}
+}
